records.key: Detection reads the image as loaded.
records.source: Detection reads the image as loaded.
records.translation: Detekteringen använder bilden som den lästes in.

records.key: Off: Otsu, Cellpose and the magnifier read the image as it was loaded (inverted if Invert is on), and Lower % / Upper % only change how it is drawn. On: they read it stretched between Lower % and Upper %, exactly as drawn, and the intensity in the top-left corner shows that stretched value. What is saved is never changed.

On: they read it stretched between Lower % and Upper %, exactly as drawn, and the intensity in the top-left corner shows that stretched value. What is saved is never changed.
records.translation: Av: Otsu, Cellpose och förstoringsglaset använder bilden som den lästes in (inverterad om Invertera är på), och Nedre % / Övre % ändrar bara hur den visas. På: de använder bilden med intensiteterna utsträckta mellan Nedre % och Övre %, precis som den visas, och intensiteten längst upp till vänster visar det utsträckta värdet. Sparade data ändras aldrig.
